title: Site builder, blog writer without the PC, redirects and noindex you can undo
changes: CMS > Site builder: the real page; click anything to change its text, link, picture, colours or size, hide it or add a block; menu, footer and logo edited on the page (replaces Template & code and Menus & footer)
Blog writer: a content plan of topic clusters (learn / compare / buy) with internal links both ways; posts at 16:00 and 23:00 Pakistan time
Blog writer can run on the server with a free Google Gemini key: no PC and no Claude subscription needed
Settings: redirects and noindex pages can be edited, stopped (the page comes back and returns to the sitemap) or changed
Pages shows the pages already on the website with their count; "Website pages & SEO" removed
steps: Upload the zip to /home2/runoncon/, unzip it, then run the installers listed in the deploy message.
